ns0:svg.ns0:title: Technical architecture of npm structural measurement
ns0:svg.ns0:desc: Public npm, deps.dev and GitHub observations feed a collection workstation and frozen SQLite archive. An illustrative maintainer-package-repository topology is evaluated using SCC condensation, endpoint unions and budgeted identity selection.

ns0:g.ns0:text: 12,217 identities · 25,228 graph IDs (2,745 contextual) · 79,405 maintainer links · 88,113 package-name edges
